Build boxes: use BB_HOST=x-boss BB_JOBS=4 just bb for every Go/Node command (this overrides the plan's x-tuf line; x-tuf is busy). Never build or test on xsm. Only gofmt, git, just isa-check and go list run locally.
This run is Tasks 1-3 only. Task 4 (live codex exec smoke) is coordinator-run later; do not create or run it, and never invoke a real `codex` binary.
No migrations, no new dependencies, no edits to internal/mcpserver/** or connectors/** except docs/connectors/codex.md (Task 3).

Known load flakes on build boxes under full-suite contention: internal/store TestTxImmediateSerialises and internal/cli TestHookHintUnboundUnchanged. If either fails, rerun that single test with -count=3 before treating it as a regression, and record it.

lensFocus.spec: This branch implements docs/plans/2026-11-04-codex-hooks.md Tasks 1-3 only (Task 4 live smoke is coordinator-run later; do not flag its absence). Check: SessionStart accepted with prompt-poll path and output named SessionStart; no automatic fresh-session binding on SessionStart; other stdin events silent without explicit --event; installer writes SessionStart/UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse into <git top>/.codex/hooks.json with timeout 5 and additionalContextLimit 18000, refuses tracked/symlinked defaults, preserves foreign hooks in order, prints the /hooks trust step, never edits trust/VCS state; docs bullets only under §13.9.
lensFocus.security: Peer text stays inert in developer-role context (wrapper and hostile golden byte-identical). Never block or fail a Codex turn: exit 0, empty stdout or one JSON object, no decision/continue/exit 2, no lifecycle handlers. Installer never touches ~/.codex trust, never suggests --dangerously-bypass-hook-trust outside the disposable smoke, never writes a personal profile into a git-tracked file.
lensFocus.tests: Every named plan test exists and fails without its fix; guard tests pass before and after; tests never touch real ~/.config/vecnet or ~/.codex; Claude installer bytes unchanged.
